definitions: A constellation in the northern sky, representing the twins Castor and Pollux.
The third astrological sign in the zodiac, originating from the constellation Gemini and traditionally spanning from May 21 to June 21.
A series of ten manned space missions undertaken by NASA from 1965 to 1966.
A family of large language models developed by Google AI.
examples: The bright stars Castor and Pollux are in Gemini.
My sister is a Gemini, born in early June.
The Gemini program was crucial for future Apollo missions.
Google's Gemini AI model is very powerful.
